summary: Learn business impact analysis for crisis and risk management with templates, recovery priorities, and BIA exercises. Enrol now.
lede: Business Impact Analysis (BIA) for Crisis and Risk Management helps you determine which activities and services are most critical, how long they can remain unavailable, and what disruption may cost. It turns process, dependency, impact, and recovery information into defensible continuity priorities, including RTO and RPO recommendations. You will learn to build process inventories, map dependencies, assess operational and financial impacts, and create recovery tiers and action plans. The course also covers practical BIA outputs such as a business impact analysis template, recovery priority matrix, dependency map, and leadership-ready summary, including the use of digital registers, shared dashboards, and AI-assisted document review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to assess disruption impact, set recovery priorities, and support continuity planning in real operational environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of organizational processes, basic risk terminology, and continuity planning concepts. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with operational units, service dependencies, and management reporting will help you apply the exercises more effectively. The course is designed at an intermediate level, so you should already have some exposure to business continuity, operational risk, crisis management, or internal control work.
